title: Act: Render inline success message after a successful send
summary: Add success state set on resolve, cleared on typing, new send or failure, and render it as role=status.
description: Add a 'success' string state to ContributionSheet and render 'Suggestion sent' in a role=status paragraph beside the existing error paragraph.
acceptance_criteria: Success message appears after resolve and not after reject.
Success message clears on typing and on the next submit.

preserve: Existing role=alert error paragraph at L135

technical_constraints: Success and error are mutually exclusive
definition_of_done: Success message visible only after a successful send

steps.action: Add state 'success' of type string | undefined initialised to undefined.

Call setSuccess(undefined) next to setError(undefined) before the request; in the try after the entries update call setSuccess('Suggestion sent'); in the catch call setSuccess(undefined) before setError.
steps.code: try { await submitContribution(prompt); setEntries(...); setSuccess('Suggestion sent'); } catch (err) { setEntries(...); setSuccess(undefined); setError(errorMessage(err)); }
steps.expected: success equals 'Suggestion sent' only after a resolved submit.

steps.action: Add setSuccess(undefined) inside the onChange handler after setValidation(undefined).
Render the success paragraph after the error paragraph.
steps.expected: A role=status element with 'Suggestion sent' shows after success.
